name: Switch: The Case of the Curious Cat
summary: Switch: The Case of the Curious Cat is a black-and-white puzzle platformer in which a detective searches for his missing cat. On this adventure, he comes across many strange obstacles, and will have to traverse in creative ways to reach new areas. For example, he might need to switch - rotating the entire world around - to find new pathways.
